items.q: Why does Nate say Dots should have been called Bugs?
items.a: About a day in, the shell feels unfinished. The DevDay **call demo failed** (muted on the stream; the room saw it). Phone and desktop were broken the night before. He still thinks **Astra is the better model** than Muse Spark. [[i-tested-openai-dots-vs-meta-muse]].

items.q: What can Dots do that Muse cannot?
items.a: He can **call** the Dot. Voice and latency are fine. That is the demo that died on stage. Muse does not have the call.

items.q: Why isn't this a Grokbot clone?
items.a: He wanted many bots that talk. Muse and Dots are **one agent** plus side chats. Grokbot stays the fleet. Average users prefer the one assistant. [[one-thread-vs-bot-fleet]].

items.q: So which one does he actually pick?
items.a: **Dots for himself**, because he already lives in Codex, Claude Code, and Slack. **Muse for his parents.** The stack you are already in picks the product. [[ecosystem-gravity-picks-the-agent]].

items.q: What is Muse's real UI wedge?
items.a: An identity tab: **soul** (persona) and **editable memory** (facts, preferences, commitments), plus a 30-minute heartbeat over Docs and email. Dot inherits old ChatGPT memory and cannot show where schedules live. [[editable-soul-and-memory]].

items.q: Why does he stop trusting the Dot?
items.a: Asked how to manage schedules, it pointed at a Profile control that is not there. Codex threads it starts miss the Herk2 project. The manual is wrong. [[agent-that-misdescribes-itself]].
